Subject: Your divorce by mutual consent matter

Dear Ms. Ghosh,

Thank you for meeting us on 15/05/2025 about your dispute with Pranav Apte. As we understand it, both spouses have lived apart for a long time.

Our advice is to apply to waive the statutory cooling-off period. Please collect proof of separate residence and the consent terms and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Aditi Ranganathan
